2228-2324-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-2324-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-2324-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

647-751-3286.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3263-4659-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-4659-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-4659-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

2586-3197-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat

1981-2415-5468-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5468-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2781-7936.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Dominion Saboteur.
2781-7936.description:
Cast Dominion Saboteur by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Dominion Saboteur enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Dominion Saboteur. Choose to have Dominion Saboteur enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-6573-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-6573-7487.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-6573-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-6573-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4499-5195-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3263-6587-7309.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
2388-3263-6587-7309.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

851-2034-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
851-2034-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

3398-7025-7122.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
3398-7025-7122.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and Avatar Roku twice.
Resolve both Avatar Roku triggers, adding twelve {R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

1170-1171-6965.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-6965.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

1497-2403-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

821-2173-5220-6094.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-413-677-4885.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1808-5226-6291.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
1808-5226-6291.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2783-2972-3875-6455.description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}{G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters, it first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Nesting Dragon trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve a Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax and Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Encroaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat

1170-2196-2493-2701.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-2196-2493-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

710-2438-2843.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

372-864-5895.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
372-864-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1987-2128-3277.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
1987-2128-3277.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Izzet Chronarch and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-4050-4939.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-4050-4939.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Burning-Tree Emissary and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

382-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Basilica Shepherd, adding {C}{C}.
When Basilica Shepherd dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Basilica Shepherd from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Basilica Shepherd enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
